support_caveats: Only platforms named in included_platforms are supplied by this package.
The Linux binary requires glibc 2.28 or newer.
Windows retains serial input pending live Break qualification.
Native Intel-host Stata testing is outstanding; the macOS plugin contains both processor slices.
The accepted Linux no-FE 16-regressor, one-worker slowdown of 7.3% versus beta.14 remains; see docs/VALIDATION.md.
performance_acceptance: Owner accepted the two inconclusive Mac cells (weak-auto-t4, weak-cmg-t4) as exceptions on 2026-11-06. Their measured status remains INCONCLUSIVE. All 12 Linux cells pass on six independent hosts; all scientific checks pass. No measurements repeated or excluded.
